column1: # RECOIL supports none of these formats. No independent decoder (Deark and ffmpeg have none) renders them, so the evidence is the cited document plus review by eye, stated per row.

column4: VMU game file (header at 0x200, two 32x32 icon frames side by side); RECOIL does not support it. Layout per Comstedt and KallistiOS vmu_pkg; render reviewed by eye: two frames of falling Tetris pieces in green and blue on the transparent grey, matching the header text "Tiny Tetris"

Neo Geo CD sprite file (2048 sprites, 32 to a row, the first holds the test letters R M O S); RECOIL does not support it. Layout per the Neo Geo Development Wiki; bit order, block order and plane 0 position checked against the tutorial's HELLO.sms source tiles; render reviewed by eye (four legible letters), and pixel-identical to the C ROM pair of the same art (hello.c1 +companions). Gray ramp is a choice
Neo Geo cartridge C ROM alone (planes 0 and 1 only, four evenly spaced grays); RECOIL does not support it. Same art as HELLO.SPR; render reviewed by eye (the same four letters)

Neo Geo C ROM pair (hello.c1 with hello.c2, renamed from the pack's hello-c1.c1 and hello-c2.c2 to share a stem); RECOIL does not support it. Pixel-identical to HELLO.SPR, which is a separate encoding of the same art (plane order 1,0,3,2 against two ROMs)

Neo Geo fix layer file (4096 tiles, 32 to a row); RECOIL does not support it. Layout per the Neo Geo Development Wiki; render reviewed by eye: a complete font (ASCII, hiragana, katakana) is legible, and the half order the wiki gives is the only one of the two that is. Gray ramp is a choice, so the glyphs (colors 1 and 2) are dark
